node.title: Re^2: Do I need/want to close __DATA__?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Here is what happens when 2 separate packages leave their DATA opened. warn reports only the last one being opened. Is it because the interpreter will detect opened DATA and localise it?

[id://11115461|As I said], the interpreter simply internally keeps track of the most recently accessed filehandle; "localise" is the wrong term here IMHO because it sounds like you mean something to do with [doc://local].
